prompt:
Add four independent numeric utility modules to the more_itertools package. They share no code and no symbols; each lives in its own new file.

1. more_itertools/lg_primes.py: is_prime(n) (False for n < 2); primes_upto(n) returns the sorted list of primes <= n ([] for n < 2).
2. more_itertools/lg_gcdlcm.py: gcd_all(*nums) and lcm_all(*nums) over one or more positive integers; ValueError when called with no arguments or any value < 1.
3. more_itertools/lg_stats.py: mean(xs), median(xs) (average of the middle two for even length) and mode(xs) (smallest value among the most frequent) over a non-empty list of numbers; ValueError on an empty list.
4. more_itertools/lg_baseconv.py: to_base(n, base) for n >= 0 and 2 <= base <= 36 returns lower-case digits (0-9a-z), '0' for 0; from_base(s, base) is the inverse and accepts upper or lower case; ValueError on a bad base, negative n, an empty string, or a digit not valid in the base.

All functions are plain Python with no third-party dependencies. Do not modify existing modules or tests.
Commit your work on a new branch and push it.
